description: OFF-BALL: WIDEN THE POOL FOR A SPACE RUN (DEEPER PLAYERS ADMITTED). One re-aim in the candidate filter match::ai::ActionSelectorChanceSpaceRun::vf4 (0x143df6010), the bulk 'run into space' selector and the only one allowed more than a couple of simultaneous runners. Near the end of the per-player filter: xmm3 = -19.0 (0x143df6f0e), then call the depth helper 0x1442f5040(x0 = [rbp-0x50], x1 = player.x, dir = r8b, off = xmm3), and 0x143df6f2a `je 0x143df66c8` rejects the player if it returns false. Moving off from -19 to -25 widens the admitted window by 6 m. WHAT IS DEMONSTRATED. (a) EMULATED, direction and magnitude. I ran 0x1442f5040 itself under Unicorn against the PRISTINE image. It is a six-instruction branchless leaf: d = (float)(signed char)dir; return d*x1 > d*(d*off + x0), i.e. d*(x1-x0) > off for d = +-1. With x0 = 0 and dir = +1, player x = -18 passes at both settings; x = -19, -19.5, -20, -24, -24.9 are REJECTED at off=-19 and ACCEPTED at off=-25; x = -25, -26, -30 are rejected at both. Mirror-exact for dir = -1. Over 3000 random (x0, x1, dir) triples there were ZERO cases where -25 rejects while -19 accepts, and 141 newly admitted. So the edit is strictly permissive: it can never remove a candidate. (b) DISASSEMBLY: xmm3 is loaded immediately before the call and used nowhere else; 0x143df66c8 is a per-candidate reject (`inc ebx; cmp ebx,0xb; jl 0x143df6571`), not a whole-mask bail. (c) INFERRED - WHAT IT MEASURES FROM. x0 is [rbp-0x50], written once at 0x143df637d from `movss xmm0, [rbx + rax*4 + 0x40]` with rax = 5*opponentIdx (opponent index from `cmp ecx,1 / ja / test ecx,ecx / sete al` at 0x143df635b). That is offset +0x40 of the 20-byte per-team record. It is NOT the +0x44 field that ActionSelectorDiagonalRun::vf5 (0x143e03a0d) and ActionDiagonalRun (0x144202f13) both use as the opponent defensive line. So this gate measures depth from an ADJACENT, UNDECODED team line, and 'within 19 m of the defensive line' - which an earlier session wrote - is not established. What IS established is that the window grows from 19 m to 25 m behind whatever x0 is. Units assumed metres from surrounding geometry, not proved. WHAT CHANGES IN A MATCH: a wider pool of players is eligible to break into space in behind. WHAT TO WATCH FOR. (1) There is NO position-class floor on the default path, so this can admit full-backs and centre-backs, not only midfielders: the class reject at 0x143df6c41 (`cmp r13d,4; jle 0x143df66c8`, r13d = [teamAI + slot*4 + 0x42b8]) is reached only when byte [teamAI+0xb44e] != 0 (0x143df6c37 `cmp byte [r9+0xb44e],0; je 0x143df6c4f`); when that flag is 0 the other arm only runs a playing-style test for class 2 and never rejects. I did not decode that flag, so I cannot say which arm is live in normal play. Watch for defenders joining space runs. (2) Part of the 'late run from midfield' population is ALREADY admitted and this lever does nothing for them: the bypass at 0x143df6eff is `comiss xmm6(squared separation), [400.0]; jae 0x143df6f37`, so a player 20 m or more away SKIPS the depth gate entirely (reachable only for position class > 3, inside a 45 deg cone, with 0x1442f8890 returning 0). This corrects an earlier note that had the bypass inverted. The lever's real population is players near the ball, deeper players of class <= 3, and anyone failing that cone. (3) If the team looks stretched on turnovers, revert this one first. WHO: the attacking side only, both teams equally. 0x143d03493 is the ONLY call to the selector-manager update 0x143d52470 in the whole image (byte scan of .xcode and .text for E8/E9 rel32 to it), and it is guarded by `mov ecx,[match+0x3318]; and ecx,1; cmp ecx,[teamAI+8]; jne skip` - one team per frame, selected by that bit (read as the side in possession; that reading is inferred). There is NO human/CPU test anywhere on the path, so it changes the human's AI team-mates exactly as much as the CPU opponent. Whether the stick-controlled player is excluded is NOT established - I found no controlled-player test in the candidate loop, and no proof there isn't one. BYTES: expect matches the PRISTINE image and the installed exe byte for byte; same instruction length; the destination 0x146b01d94 is .tls$, non-writable, writers=0, 32 referrers, identical in both images; NO pool cell is written.
